Create an ORIGINAL Phobos spacecraft equipment sprite for the Fennmark L2 Canister Filling Station, a 2 by 2 floor unit with native 32 x 32 pixels. Reference 1 is our newly approved Fennmark V4 refinery: follow its detailed but restrained industrial pixel finish, materials and maker palette. Reference 2 is our older L2: keep its functional role and full square deck, improve the mechanical design.

High-resolution square canvas, at least 1024 x 1024. Fully opaque machinery deck reaches all four edges, fills every corner, no margin, background or transparent gaps. Back edge at TOP, crew access at BOTTOM. Graphite enamel perimeter, muted burnt-orange corner clamps and latches, pale sand-grey metal deck, blackened steel working blocks with dull copper connections. TOP LEFT: a broad strapped rectangular compressor/booster casing with two ribs, compact and visibly different from a chemical reactor lid. TOP RIGHT: recessed closed service hatch and a round black filter cap. Across the LOWER half: four stout capped canister coupling sockets in one readable row, empty of canisters, on a dark inset rail, one small blue oxygen fitting. Small grille along the bottom edge. No green lamps, painted monitor, gauges or level strip. Broad mechanical shapes clear at 32 x 32; durable spacecraft engineering, restrained enamel chips at bolts.

Deliberate coarse pixel art with stepped contours, dark seams, strong recesses and flat two/three-step shading, matching the approved reference. Not a flat diagram and not a glossy product render. No lettering, numbers, logos, decals, screens, dials, lamps, live-state instruments, people, workpieces or consumables. No pipes or cables beyond the footprint. No ground shadow, floor, tilted square, diamond projection, perspective, front or side faces. Only top surfaces.
